kaalka_source_of_truth: official Kaalka v5.0.0 (PyPI kaalka / npm kaalka / pub.dev kaalka) — byte _proc contract; no fork, no custom cryptography

encrypt_value.python: core/crypto/kaalka_runtime_engine.py: stable_serialize(value) -> UTF-8 -> derive_kaalka_time_key(key) -> kaalka_v5_proc(encrypt) -> base64
encrypt_value.javascript: src/crypto/kaalkaRuntime.ts: stableSerialize -> UTF-8 -> deriveKaalkaTimeKey -> kaalkaV5EncryptBytes -> base64
encrypt_value.dart: lib/src/crypto/kaalka_runtime.dart: stableSerialize -> UTF-8 -> deriveKaalkaTimeKey -> kaalkaV5EncryptBytes -> base64 (package:kaalka registry)

time_key_derivation.all_languages: sha256(NFKC-normalized key) -> first digest triple (d[i]%12, d[i+1]%60, d[i+2]%60) that round-trips -> 'h:m:s'
time_key_derivation.preprocessing: normalize_runtime_value: NFKC, CRLF->LF, strip trailing whitespace
time_key_derivation.verified: identical time_key in all 3 languages for the verifier key

hashing.note: compute_kaalka_hash is an alias in all three languages

fingerprinting.all_languages: hex_fingerprint = kaalka v1 byte cipher ((n XOR token[i%len]) + i*31 + len%251, double-modulo) over dumps_deterministic payload, hex output

decryption.all_languages: base64 decode -> kaalka_v5_proc(decrypt) -> UTF-8; roundtrip verified for all 1100 vectors in all 3 languages

serialization_contract.string_normalization: NFKC + CRLF->LF + trailing-whitespace strip on top-level strings; NFC on fingerprint-path strings
serialization_contract.key_ordering: Unicode code-point order (Python sorted semantics) — JS/Dart UTF-16 default sort replaced
serialization_contract.numbers: integral floats < 2^63 -> int; non-finite -> null (stable path) / 0 (fingerprint path); fractional floats: shortest round-trip digits, Python repr thresholds (positional for exponent in [-4,15], else e+NN with 2-digit-minimum exponent); .15g rounding on fingerprint path applies to fractional values only
serialization_contract.volatile_keys: timestamp, created_at, updated_at, nonce, request_id, csrf, generated_at, runtime_id, random, uuid — stripped from dicts and from dicts directly inside list values; not stripped inside lists nested in lists (all languages identical)
serialization_contract.arrays: stable path serializes top-level arrays as index-keyed objects (historical fast-json-stable-stringify shape)

dart_standalone: no Process.run / shell / Node delegation anywhere in lib/; NFKC via pure-Dart package:unorm_dart 0.3.2, byte-verified against Python unicodedata and V8 ICU on multilingual probes
evidence: cross_language_verifier/: 1100 vectors x 6 fields + time_key = 6601 comparisons, byte-identical, 3 runs per language, certification_report.json verdict PASS
